in_marathi.name: Karankumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karankumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kara: God's Grace, Anu: Birth, Kuma: Desire or Prosperity. This name signifies being born with the grace of the gods and the desire for prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Karankumar

in_bengali.long_meaning: Karankumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kara: God's Grace, Anu: Birth, Kuma: Desire or Prosperity. This name signifies being born with the grace of the gods and the desire for prosperity.
